points.text: An Israeli airstrike hit Nasser Hospital in southern Gaza, killing at least six people, including a surgeon, and injuring others, according to Gaza health authorities.
Indonesia’s Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned amid an eligibility dispute following court rulings concerning documents he submitted.
A three-story building collapsed near a construction site in Brooklyn’s Flatbush neighborhood, killing at least two people and injuring more than 10 as rescue efforts continued.
Nvidia named CFO Colette Kress interim CEO after Jensen Huang’s departure; Kress is expected to remain CFO, and Elon Musk said hiring Huang would be an honor.
Donald Trump said the United States does not need a deal with Iran and directed Vice President JD Vance to focus on domestic issues rather than negotiations.
